messages:
jamie: Seeing p99 spikes on tiny inference when staging pool fragmented. median ok, p99 ~200ms.

nina: Looks like many sg entries -> many pin syscalls.

ode: Options: reserve slab pool, coalesce copy to contiguous slab, or batched pin syscall (not portable).

jamie: proposal: reserve 256k slabs for latency-sensitive routes; fallback to coalesce up to X bytes. expose QoS flag per-request.

nina: need indirection in KV entries to move pages safely. handle id + generation with CAS swap. small pointer indirection cost <5ns.

ode: telemetry needed: sg_entries, reserve_hits, consolidate_ops, consolidate_bytes. tenant token-bucket for fairness.

perf-bot: queued perf job=perf-9199991111, scenarios=[mixed_small_batch], artifacts=/perf/9199991111

jamie: I'll open prototype PR behind feature flag and minimal RFC for indirection.
